description: Defines the abstract class TextureStorage9 and its derived classes for managing D3D9 textures, including 2D, cube, and EGL image textures, with methods for surface retrieval, mipmap generation, and data copying.

classes.name: TextureStorage9
classes.description: Abstract base class for D3D9 texture storage, providing interface for surface access, mipmap generation, and data management.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_2D
classes.description: Concrete class for 2D D3D9 textures, supporting surface retrieval, render target access, mipmap generation, and copying.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_EGLImage
classes.description: Concrete class for EGL image-backed D3D9 textures, supporting surface and render target access.

classes.name: TextureStorage9_Cube
classes.description: Concrete class for cube map D3D9 textures, supporting surface retrieval, render target access, and mipmap generation.

methods.name: GetTextureUsage
methods.description: Static method to determine texture usage flags based on internal format and render target status.

methods.name: getPool
methods.description: Returns the D3D pool type of the texture.

methods.name: getUsage
methods.description: Returns the usage flags of the texture.

methods.name: getSurfaceLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the surface level of the texture at a specified level.

methods.name: getBaseTexture
methods.description: Retrieves the base D3D texture object.

methods.name: isRenderTarget
methods.description: Indicates if the texture is a render target.

methods.name: isManaged
methods.description: Indicates if the texture is managed.

methods.name: supportsNativeMipmapFunction
methods.description: Checks if native mipmap functions are supported.

methods.name: getLevelCount
methods.description: Returns the number of mipmap levels.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets texture data for a specific level and image index.

methods.name: TextureStorage9_2D
methods.description: Constructor for 2D texture storage, supporting surface and render target retrieval, mipmap generation, and copying.

methods.name: TextureStorage9_EGLImage
methods.description: Constructor for EGL image-backed texture storage.

methods.name: TextureStorage9_Cube
methods.description: Constructor for cube map texture storage.
